causal_score: sum conditional token log probabilities; marginalize the other feature over four fixed bilingual continuations
causal_gate: positive headline target contrast on at least 6/8 anchors and larger median target contrast than both random directions
generation_intervention: last original prompt token only; recomputed at that fixed position on every uncached full forward
specificity: Report target and off-target effects; do not infer disentanglement from low input cosine alone.
scope: Direction validation only. No FSEC surface or exponent fit.
revision_note: Bounded exploratory amplitude diagnostic after v2 failed at 30 degrees; same frozen block8 directions and test anchors. Adds downstream L2 to distinguish weak output effects from small activation effects. No new direction selection or refit.
